programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-experten Friar hittar en bomb med tryckkänslig utlösare under sin skrivbordsstol och en osynlig hackare tvingar honom att stjäla digitala medel på nätet – för annars kommer Friars dotter att föras bort.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
programme.desc: Mike är inte längre huvudperson och Angelina öppnar sig för de andra.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Maci storgrälar med Ryan om vårdnaden om deras son Bentley, medan Amber och Gary försöker hitta ett sätt att ta hand om Leah tillsammans trots kontaktförbudet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Kaitlyn Farrington
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av "Ridiculousness" kommer guldmedaljören Kaitlyn Farrington till Rob, Sterling och Chanel för att prata om "De andra Sotjispelen", "Petfobi" och vad det innebär att vara "LARP-oskuld".

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Rob's Parents II
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' tar Rob, Chanel och Steelo emot Robs föräldrar för lite 'Patdiculousness'med mamma, storhetsdåd med 'Genes gener' och lär sig att den största striden är 'Pappa mot blöja'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal V
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness försöker Rob, Steelo och Nina Agdal ta reda på varför 'Grabbar älskar farligheter', rulllar mat-tärningen och förlorar i 'Det har gått ut' och njuter av vyn från de billiga platserna i 'Läktarbeteende'.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: Hej då, tjejen
programme.desc: Alla går på fest för att Jeremiah ska få nåt annat att tänka på än sin farfars död. Men Nilsa blir full och förstör kvällen genom att starta ett storbråk med Aimee. Candace och Kortni planerar en tjejresa för att ställa allt till rätta.

programme.title: MTV Floribama Shore: Exposed
programme.desc: När Josh och Lenns dyker upp riskerar saker och ting att vändas upp och ner i Lake Havasu. Och när Jeremiah tar dem åt sidan för att prata enskilt, triggas Gus svartsjuka. Gänget spelar några rundor Grand Theft Golf Car.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction
programme.desc: Jessica Biel, James Van Der Beek och Ian Somerhalder ger liv och skratt åt denna ärliga, vågade titt på sociala och sexuella relationer på college.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tonåringarna Eddie och Amber växer upp i en irländsk småstad under 1990-talet. Alla misstänker att de är gay och varje dag är en kamp. De blir ihop på låtsas och inser att en påhittad relation kan vara minst lika komplicerad som en äkta.

programme.title: Ruskiga Rekryter - In war with the army
programme.desc: Alvin (Jerry Lewis) och Vic (Dean Martin) är kompisar som söker värvning i armén, främst därför att Vic har problem med sin flickvän och söker sig via det militära till en tjänstgöring i Europa.

programme.title: Kör hårt
programme.desc: Rullskridskoåkaren Rosco lurar kåkfararen Doug att spöa upp några långtradarchaufförer som trängt honom av vägen. De får en väska fylld med dollar, en svit på Miamis finaste hotell och order att utge sig för att vara nyrika lantisar.

programme.title: Nu ger vi järnet
programme.desc: Helt otroligt! Trinitybrorsorna har fått jobb. Som piloter! Mitt i amazonas djungler. Mitt bland ett gäng diamantskurkar som är det värsta gäng rövare världen skådat näst vår regering.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 629
programme.desc: Första dagen av finalveckan! Deltagarna inleder veckan med ännu en lång och hektisk dag i köket. Kjartan har höga förväntningar på finalisterna och förväntar sig en hög servicenivå.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 630
programme.desc: Ett steg närmare finalen för de återstående deltagarna! På dag två av finalveckan utmanar Kjartan finalisternas smaklökar. Dagen slutar med att ännu en finalist måste åka hem.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 631
programme.desc: Finalen närmar sig med stormsteg! De återstående finalisterna vill alla vara med i finalen, men idag måste de kommunicera bra med varandra för att nå dit.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 632
programme.desc: Tre förväntansfulla deltagare är redo för årets semifinal. Kjartan testar de tävlande i precision, teknik och snabbhet innan den första finalisten väljs ut.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 633
programme.desc: Sista dagen på Camp Kulinaris! De tidigare deltagarna är tillbaka! Till stor glädje och motivation för de två finalisterna. Det är upplagt för en spännande finaldag - vem kommer att gå segrande?

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 312
programme.desc: Vi möter Angelina gjort bröstkirurgi 11 gånger. I sökandet efter drömbrösten reser hon till Miami, där hon lägger in 1500 ml i brösten och det slutar med att de blir så stora att de spricker.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 308
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Britt, som är upprörd både över utseendet på hennes bröst och den smärta hon fått efter en mastektomi och drömmer om ett bröllop med fina bröst och utan smärta.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Vi möter Jeanette som känner sig som en försökskanin efter en rad misslyckade operationer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 705

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 406
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Anita som vaknade upp med större bröst än vad hon hade kommit överens om med kirurgen och som nu känner sig som en miniversion av Linse Kessler.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 102

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia

programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Lawman Ed Cantrell, known as "the fastest draw in the West", kills one of his drug agents, Michael Rosa, in an Old West-style shootout in 1978. In court, the jury heard two completely different stories.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Scrambled Eggs
programme.desc: Police investigate a possible suicide in a burned vehicle, a person is assaulted with eggs and a group of car thieves causes a police pursuit.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A financier lives after his socialite wife shoots him six times in their Calgary condo.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a loving wife and mother are found stabbed to death inside her home, a team of investigators dedicates eight years to finding her killer. Ultimately, an undercover sting operation uncovers a world of lies, betrayal, and terror.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of

programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E07.Employment Scam & Adoption Fraud
programme.desc: A college student trying to earn some extra cash and finds himself involved in a job where instead of making money, he loses it due to a fraudulent cheque

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Vampire Diaries

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: Three Bizarre Cases of Alien Abductions
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane examine three compelling cases of alien abduction and the mysteries of the universe.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar baddagen / Cirkusvalptister
programme.desc: Det är en riktigt varm dag, och valparna beger sig till vattenparken. Men poolen är tom! Nu måste Paw Patrol rädda dagen! // När cirkusdjuren inte dyker upp i tid måste Ryder och Paw Patrol ställa upp istället!

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Turning the Tide
programme.desc: Allies turn the tide in the Atlantic, where initially German U-Boats harass freely convoys to supply Britain. The route to bring American soldiers who will land on D-Day is clear.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.
